book.name: Leta po Sos blo Kolosi
book.title: Leta po Sos blo Kolosi prom Pol

content: Ai prapa wande yupla ol dem Kristian de wea Kolosi ane da taun blo Ladasia, po sabe ai bin wok prapa ad po elpe yupla, ane po dem nada Kristian de tu uda i no bin luk pes blo mi.
Ai prapa wok ad po meke yupla po kam nadakain strong ane po gad lab wea at po wananada. I diskain solong yupla go gede ebridem gudsamting ane go prapa sabe baut da sikret trutok uda i Zizas Kraist.
Ane i Kraist nau uda i soe yupla ol dem gudsamting ane gudsens po wanem God i wandem.
Ai tok demkain ya solong nobodi i ken swite yupla wea olkain swittok, bat dem swittok blo dempla i prapa ol laitok.
Nomata ai no de wea yupla, bat tingking blo mi i mata de wea yupla. Ane ai prapa nadakain api po yupla bikoz ai sabe yupla mata meke ol samting wea raitwei bikoz yupla mata bilib wea Kraist.
Mata kip bilib lo Kraist
Yupla bin teke Zizas Kraist po Bos blo yupla. Wa, yupla mas mata lisen po em ane pole em.
Yupla mas gro lo Zizas. Em da strong paundeisan wea yupla mas bilde laip blo yupla, so yupla i go kip kam mostrong prom mata bilib lo tising blo Kraist. Yupla mas gibe mina big eso po God.

Yupla mas prapa lugaut yuplaselp prom demwan uda i go lide yupla go rongwei wea olkain stupittok. Dem nada tok i saun gud, bat i kam prom tingking blo man ane nugudwei blo dis wold. I no kam prom tising blo Kraist.
Bikoz ebriting blo God i stap wea Kraist ane ebriting blo Kraist i stap wea God.
God i bin meke yupla laip mata rait prom mata stap klostu wea Kraist. Kraist i bos oba ebridem bos blo debolspirit uda i stap wea dis wold ane oba ebri demwan uda kare lo.
Bikoz yupla i mata klostu wea Kraist, yupla bin kate poskin, bat i no da poskin blo da bodi. I Kraist uda i bin kate yupla aut prom dem oulwei blo yupla.

Seimkainwei wiskain Kraist i bin ded, yupla bin ded tu wen yupla bin baptaiz lo wata. Ane yupla i bin kam po stap wea niulaip tu seimkain wiskain Kraist i bin kam po mata stap wea niulaip. Yupla bin bilib lo da strongpaua blo God uda i bin meke Kraist po kamlaipgen prom ded.

Laip blo yupla pastaim i bin wase ol ded pipol bikoz yupla i bin mata meke ol nugud samting. Dem nugudwei blo yupla i no bin kamaut yet, bat diskaintaim nau God i bin meke yupla kam po mata stap laip. Bikoz prom Kraist, em bin pogib ebridem nugudwei blo yumpla.
God i bin teke dem rekod blo dem nugudting wea yumpla i bin mekem ane em bin pinis smasem wea dat kros blo Kraist.
God i bin pait ane win gense dem bos blo debolspirit ane dem debolspirit uda i kare lo. Em bin meke dempla sem prant wea ol pipol wen em bin smase demting de wea da kros blo Kraist.

So yupla lisen prapa gud. No lete nobodi zaze yupla po dem kaikai yupla kaikai, o dem dringk wea yupla dringk, o ip yupla no pole eni spesil preadei, o spesil preataim wase taim blo niumun, o dem preataim blo dem Zuwis Sabatdei.
Bikoz demwei blo wosip i no da prapawei, mata Kraist i da prapawei.

Yupla mas no lete nobodi po pose yupla po meke samting wea dempla spik i rait, bat prapa, dempla i rong. No lete dempla spik yupla mas wosip einzel nomata dempla spik dempla i bin luk bizin prom einzel. Demkain pipol i spik dempla i prapa ambol, bat prapa, dempla gad nugud tingking wea i meke dempla praud.

Demkain pipol i no zoin tugeda lo Kraist wea em i da ed blo da bodi. Bat yumpla i zoin tugeda lo bodi blo Kraist bikoz prom dat strongpaua blo em ane yumpla go gro kam mostrong wen yumpla lisen da mesiz wanem God i gibe yumpla.
Yupla i bin ded tugeda lo Kraist ane em i bin meke yupla pri prom dem debolspirit paua blo dis wold. Bat aukam yupla kip pole dem rul blo da wold,
wase, ‘No kese demting wea an, no kaikai demting ane no tase demting?’
Demwan i ol rul blo man. I nogo las long bikoz i wase kaikai, i go pinis.

Demkain rul blo meke demkainting i luk gud, bat prapa, dem rul i mekem prapa ad, bikoz ebribodi sabe yumpla mas bi nadakain strong ane trai po bi ambol po mekem. Bat dem rul nogo seinze rong tingking blo yumpla ane rongwei blo yumpla, ane yumpla go endap praud. Dem rul blo man kan meke yumpla bos blo bodi blo yumpla.
